question: Who among the following is NOT a Kathak dancer?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ananda Shankar**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Ananda Shankar:-**

 
 
• **He was an Indian musician, singer, and composer best known for fusing Western and Eastern musical styles. He was not a Kathak Dancer.**
 
• He was the son of dancer and choreographer Uday Shankar and the nephew of sitar player Ravi Shankar.
 
• Ananda Shankar was a pioneer of fusion music.
 
• He combined the traditional sounds of the sitar and tabla with Western rock, jazz, and electronic music to create a new and unique sound.
 
• His music was both innovative and accessible, and it helped to introduce Indian music to a new audience.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sitara Devi:-**

 
 
• **She was an Indian dancer of the classical Kathak style of dancing, a singer, and an actress. **
 
• She was the recipient of several awards and accolades, and performed at several prestigious venues in India and abroad; including the Royal Albert Hall, London (1967) and at the Carnegie Hall, New York (1976).
 
 
 
• **Gopi Krishna:-**
 
 
• **He was an Indian Kathak dancer, actor, and choreographer. **
 
• He also studied Bharatnatyam.
 
• In 1952, at the age of seventeen, Gopi Krishna became one of the youngest choreographers in Hindi film history when he was hired to choreograph dances for Madhubala in the film Saqi.
 
 
 
• **Shambu Maharaj:-**
 
 
• **He was an Indian Kathak dancer, choreographer, and teacher. **
 
• He is considered to be one of the greatest Kathak dancers of all time.
